At the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “ Annual Meeting ”) of Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “ Company ” or “ Sunbelt ”), held on September 1, 2026, Sunbelt’s stockholders (i) elected each of the Company’s ten director nominees to serve until the Company’s 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders; (ii) approved (on a non-binding, advisory basis) the compensation paid to the Company’s named executive officers; (iii) approved (on a non-binding, advisory basis) “1 Year” as the frequency of future stockholder advisory votes on executive compensation; and (iv) approved the ratification of the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending April 30, 2027.
